Name: Amasai, Chief of Captains
Summary: Chief of the captains upon whom the spirit came, who declared, Thine are we, David, and on thy side.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:18: Chief of the captains upon whom the spirit came, who declared, Thine are we, David, and on thy side.
LifeLesson: The mention of Amasai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
